story.title: The Silence Debt
story.logline: A woman pays to keep her terrible secrets quiet, only to discover the vault is actually collecting something far more vital than money.
story.theme: The true cost of unspoken truth
story.twist: The bank doesn't store her secrets to hide them; it uses them to build physical bodies for the people she wronged.
story.ending: Who will you forgive today, before your voice runs out completely?

scenes.narration: They charged me five hundred dollars just to whisper my darkest secret into a cold metal drain.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, a 25-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a worn denim jacket, stands inside a damp concrete vault.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on lips whispering into a rusted brass drain.

scenes.narration: The bank promised total silence. Every payment buys another month of absolute peace from my past mistakes.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, worn denim jacket, swipes her phone against a glowing terminal in the damp concrete vault.
scenes.camera: Medium shot tracking her hand, glowing blue light on her face.

scenes.narration: My account balance is hitting zero. If I miss today's payment, the vault releases everything to the public.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, worn denim jacket, stares in horror at a flashing red screen in the damp concrete vault.
scenes.camera: Close-up on phone screen showing zero balance.

scenes.narration: I begged the teller for an extension. She just pointed at the heavy vault door slowly sliding shut.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, worn denim jacket, bangs on a massive steel door inside the damp concrete vault.
scenes.camera: Wide shot showing her tiny form against the giant closing door.

scenes.narration: The lock clicked. But inside, there was no escape hatch, only rows of glowing glass jars lining the walls.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, worn denim jacket, trapped in a room of glowing glass jars inside the concrete vault.
scenes.camera: Pan across shelves filled with pulsing colored light.

scenes.narration: Inside each jar floated a shape. Not a file, not a recording, but a tiny, breathing human heart.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, worn denim jacket, peers closely at a pulsing glass jar in the concrete vault.
scenes.camera: Macro shot of a tiny beating heart suspended in fluid.

scenes.narration: A speaker crackled to life. The bank doesn't store secrets to hide them. It harvests them to build lives.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, worn denim jacket, covers her ears as a metallic speaker crackles in the concrete vault.
scenes.camera: Medium shot over her shoulder at an old intercom.

scenes.narration: Every lie I paid to bury became flesh. Down here, my silence literally grew into the people I hurt.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, worn denim jacket, watches shadows forming into human silhouettes inside the concrete vault.
scenes.camera: Wide low angle as figures materialize from mist.

scenes.narration: The glass in front of me cracked. A hand reached out from the jar, cold and demanding my name.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, worn denim jacket, recoils as a pale hand bursts from glass in the concrete vault.
scenes.camera: Close-up on shattering glass and reaching fingers.

scenes.narration: Who will you forgive today, before your voice runs out completely and takes your body with it?
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, dark messy hair, worn denim jacket, fading into mist inside the dark concrete vault.
scenes.camera: Dolly back as she dissolves into glowing particles.

caption.hook: Her secrets weren't buried, they were building.
caption.title: The Silence Debt
caption.caption: She thought she was buying peace with silver, but the vault demands a flesh-and-blood toll. Every secret she whispered into the dark has finally taken a step toward her front door. What happens when your sins start breathing?
